observations: Source-blind Vera examination of the built preview at 390x844 in two real Chromium contexts. Capable context: the accessible-name button 'Avisos de este spot' resolved at 332 x 44 px, hit-tested with elementFromPoint at its centre so it is genuinely tappable and uncovered, white on dark green at about 6.7:1 contrast; no 'listo', 'activo', 'activado' or 'avisos activos' anywhere in the page text. Incapable context, reproduced by deleting window.PushManager and ServiceWorkerRegistration.prototype.pushManager before load and verifying both deletions still held after the page's own code ran: the container was never unhidden, the button had no rendered box at all, and the word 'aviso' appears nowhere; the page ends cleanly with no gap or ghost control. Neither context claims avisos are already active. U8: scrollWidth equalled clientWidth equalled 390 px in every context; reduced motion checked by computed style (transitionDuration 0s, animationName none) at rest and on focus; dark theme verified to have actually reached the page via matchMedia before judging, and the site ships a single palette so dark renders pixel-identical to light while staying legible. Not examined and not claimed: permission prompt, refusal wording, return-visit claim, 'listo' timing, retry on save failure, unrecognised destination, one-tap removal - all need the deployed write path, which does not exist yet.
u8_observation: En la página de Playa Venao a 390 px aparece la línea de avisos de este spot como una acción que puedo tocar; en un teléfono que no puede pedir avisos esa acción no aparece por ninguna parte, y en ninguno de los dos casos la página dice que ya tengo avisos activos.
